thread:
alex: Heads-up — p95 east-west latency spike across gpu-pool-us-west2 during peak batching window (09:28–09:50 UTC). Affected racks: r4, r5, r6. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc123/batching-latency :eyes:

marta: seeing it. p95 jumped to ~120ms from baseline ~6ms. Started ~09:26. Rack heatmap shows r5 worst. :grimacing:

sam: can you paste ethtool/ib stats from an affected node?

jin: grabbed a quick snapshot from gnode-45 (r5) about 09:34:
```
$ sudo ethtool -S eth0 | egrep 'rx_length|rx_missed|tx_aborted|rx_dropped'
rx_length_errors: 4321
rx_missed_errors: 120
tx_aborted_errors: 98
rx_dropped: 10450
```
and `ibv_devinfo -v` shows repeated "AQ error" on mlx5_0.

ops-oncall: I'm throttling batch ingress for gpu-pool-us-west2 to reduce pressure while we triage. Moving new jobs off r5.

alex: @infra-bot start pcap on gnode-45 / gnode-48 for 5m (capture interface eth0)

infra-bot: pcap started: /var/log/pcaps/2829998888-gnode-45.pcap and /var/log/pcaps/2829998888-gnode-48.pcap. Will auto-upload to S3 when finished.

sam: quick checks to run if you hit this locally:
- sudo ethtool -S eth0 | egrep 'rx_length|rx_missed|tx_aborted|rx_dropped'
- sudo ibv_devinfo -v | grep -i error
- sudo tc -s qdisc show dev eth0
- sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 | egrep 'mlx5|eth0|rdma|TCP'
- sudo ip link show | grep mtu

marta: ran ip link on gnode-45 & gnode-48:
gnode-45: mtu 1500 on eth0
gnode-48 (r6): mtu 9000 on eth0
That looks bad — r5 NICs got set to 1500 while r6 remains 9000.

jin: that explains fragmentation + huge rx_dropped counts and ib timeouts — RDMA expects consistent MTU along the path. Any config changes last night?

sam: checking config-management changelog — a network profile rollout targeted r5 yesterday at 02:14 with new template that omitted mtu: 9000 (defaulted to 1500). Rolling back now.

ops-oncall: cordoning r5 nodes and draining batch pods. Starting rolling MTU fix via cm: `cmtool apply network-profile mtu-9000 --selector rack=r5` — will push out in waves of 10 nodes. ETA ~12m.

alex: after cordon+rollback — please rewarm KV cache on a few nodes once they come back. We saw elevated latency due to cache coldness too, so include that in mitigation.

infra-bot: config-change event: network-profile rollback applied to r5 (50/50 nodes updated).

marta: p95 back to ~8ms on r4/r6; r5 improving as nodes update. Nice work. :tada:

alex: action items (post-incident):
- add MTU drift alert to Console (detect mismatch between node and TOR)
- gate config-rollouts to validate mtu field for network-profile templates
- add ibv/ethtool error metrics to infra SLO dashboard
- include an automated preflight that checks ip link show across a rack during rollout

jin: I'll own the dashboard + alert. Sam — can you add the rollout gate in config-management?

sam: on it, PR incoming in 30m.

ops-oncall: uncordoning r5 as nodes finish updating. No further job failures reported.

alex: great runbook-worthy incident — short but caused p95 spikes across the pooling window. We'll include troubleshooting steps in the runbook.

marta: saving pcaps and logs to the incident folder now: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2829998888/pcaps-logs.zip

infra-bot: upload complete.
